en.admin.bulkRepriceBody: Every variant of each product moves by the same percentage. Was-prices and member prices are left as they are.
en.admin.bulkStatusBody: Each one is checked as if you changed it alone. Any that cannot change stay as they are and are listed afterwards.
en.admin.selectPage: Select every product on this page
en.admin.noSalesYet: No sales in the last 30 days.
en.admin.salesNote: From orders as placed. Cancelled items and exchange replacements are left out, and days are Kuwait's.
en.returnsPage.exchangeBody: Ask for the same item again instead of a refund. If none is left by the time yours is back, you are refunded instead and told why.
en.returnsPage.otherBody: Tell us what happened and a person at the shop reads it and answers.
en.returnsPage.mindBody: Approved too, except perishable groceries, which cannot go back on a shelf.
en.returnsPage.mindTitle: Changed your mind, or the wrong size
en.returnsPage.faultBody: Approved the moment you ask, inside the window.
en.returnsPage.faultTitle: Damaged, faulty, wrong or not as described
en.returnsPage.startNote: Open the order, then press Return or exchange beside the item. The time left is shown beside each one.
en.returnsPage.start: Start a return from your orders
en.returnsPage.intro: You have {days} days from delivery to send an item back for a refund or swap it for the same thing again.
en.returnsPage.title: Returns and exchanges
en.home.heroNote: Shop stores from across Kuwait in one place, and get it all delivered to your door.
en.stores.title: Stores
en.stores.emptyNote: Stores appear here once they have something on sale.
en.stores.notFoundNote: The address may be mistyped, or the store is not selling on NetLet right now.
en.stores.emptyShelf: Nothing on sale here right now
en.stores.emptyShelfNote: This store has no products on sale at the moment. Other stores on NetLet do.
en.stores.noMatchNote: Try another word, or another of the store's departments.
en.rail.bestsellers.title: Bestsellers
en.admin.variantPhotoHint: Picking a colour shows the first photo whose description names it, such as “Smart watch in black”.
en.admin.variantsByName: Shoppers will choose these by name. Give each variant a value for the same options, such as Colour and Storage, and they are shown as choices instead.
en.admin.optionTooLong: Keep a name under 60 characters and a value under 120.
en.admin.optionDuplicate: Each option name can be used once on a variant.
en.admin.optionHalf: Give every option both a name and a value.
en.admin.variantOptionsHint: What tells this variant apart, such as Colour: Black or Storage: 256 GB.
en.features.why.voiceBrowser: Shown in browsers that can listen — Chrome, Edge and Safari; absent elsewhere.
en.features.why.recommendationsWhere: Shown on the Saved page to a signed-in shopper, once they have saved, bagged or bought enough to go on.
en.features.why.noPairs: Not showing yet: it appears on a product once an order has held it with something else.
en.features.why.aiOff: Not showing: "AI features" is switched off on this page.
en.features.why.noGateway: Not showing: the AI gateway is not connected (AI_GATEWAY_URL and AI_GATEWAY_SECRET). Add both in the deployment's settings.
en.admin.arabicDraftUnavailable: No draft right now — please type the Arabic name.
en.admin.arabicDraftNote: A first draft from the English name, written into the box for you to read and change before saving.
en.admin.genIntro: Write what you know and add a photo or two. AI drafts the name in English and Arabic, both descriptions, the department, its specifications and tags — and nothing goes into the form until you choose.
en.admin.genNotesHint: The maker, the model, sizes, colours, what is in the box. The price and the stock are yours to set below.
en.admin.genNotesPlaceholder: Samsung Galaxy A55, 256 GB, 8 GB memory, navy, charger and case in the box, one-year warranty
en.admin.genPhotosHint: The first three photos uploaded here or in step 2. A photo added by its web address is not sent.
en.admin.genPhotosNone: None yet — notes alone work too.
en.admin.genNeedInput: Write a few notes or upload a photo first.
en.admin.genDraftNote: Written by AI from your notes and photos, and it can be wrong. Check every fact before you use it.
en.admin.genMissing: Not in your notes or photos: {fields}.
en.admin.genSeoNote: For reference only: NetLet does not keep a separate search title or description yet, so search results show the product's name and description.
en.admin.genUseNote: Fills the names, descriptions, department, specifications and tags below; you can change any of them before you create the product.
en.admin.genApplied: Draft filled in. Read each field before you create the product.
en.admin.genErrorBusy: That is a lot of drafts in a minute. Try again shortly.
en.admin.genErrorTooLarge: That is too much to send at once. Shorten the notes or use fewer photos.
en.admin.genErrorRefused: AI would not draft this one. Check the notes and try again.
en.admin.genErrorFailed: No draft came back this time. Try again in a moment, or add more detail.
en.admin.fieldDescriptionArHint: Shown on the Arabic page. Left empty, the Arabic page shows the description above.
en.admin.newSpecsHint: From the AI draft. Change or remove any of them; the rest of the specifications are in the editor once the product is created.
en.admin.newPhotoAdded: Photo added. It is saved with the product when you create it.
en.admin.newWarrantyHint: As you would say it to the buyer. Shown on the product page and attributed to your store.
en.admin.newWarrantyRequired: State the warranty — an electronics product cannot go on sale without one ("No warranty" is an answer).
en.admin.newTitleArRequired: Give the Arabic name — it is what the Arabic shop shows.
en.admin.needsWarranty: An electronics product needs its warranty stated before it goes on sale — add a Warranty row under Specifications ("12 months", or "No warranty").
en.checkout.badPhone: Check the mobile number — it should be an eight-digit Kuwaiti number.
en.checkout.needPhone: Add a mobile number the driver can call.
en.checkout.needAddress: Enter the block, street and building.
en.checkout.needGovernorate: Choose the governorate to deliver to.
en.checkout.needCod: Cash on delivery isn't available for this cart — see the note above.
en.checkout.needItems: Add something to your cart first.
en.delivery.guestZones: Or choose a governorate to see delivery prices
en.delivery.signInNote: Sign in to deliver to your saved addresses, or to add one.
en.delivery.needsGovernorate: Add its governorate to deliver here
en.delivery.firstNote: Save where you'd like your orders delivered. You can add more later and switch between them here.
en.delivery.addressNote: Choose where your order goes. Its governorate sets each seller's delivery fee, which your bag shows before you order.
en.delivery.title: Deliver to
en.address.needsGovernorate: Choose the governorate — it decides each seller's delivery fee.
en.voucher.tooMany: Too many codes that did not match have been tried from here. Try again in an hour.
en.admin.cancelLastLineBody: This is the last item on the order, so the order closes. The units go back on the shelf, nothing is collected, and anything the shopper paid with a gift card or points goes back to them. A closed order cannot be restored.
en.orders.orderClosed: Every item on this order was cancelled, so the order is closed and the shopper's gift card and points went back to them. It cannot be reopened; the shopper can order again.
en.stock.wrongDirection: That reason goes the other way: received and returned add stock, sold and damaged take it away. Use a correction for a miscount.
en.stock.zeroChange: Type how many units changed. A change of nothing records nothing.
en.search.refineTooMany: That is a lot of refined searches. The standard results are below, or try again in a while.
en.admin.markPaidBody: Do this once the bank transfer has gone out. It is recorded against this cash-out and cannot be undone from here.
en.admin.collectedBody: This marks the order paid, issues its invoice, and from then on its items can no longer be cancelled — only refunded.
en.admin.collectedTitle: Record the cash for {reference} as collected?
en.admin.cancelLineBody: The units go back on the shelf, the shopper is not charged for it, and the driver collects that much less. You can restore it later while it is still in stock — unless nothing else on the order is still coming, in which case the order closes for good.
en.admin.revokeAdminBody: They lose the whole admin panel straight away. Their account, their orders and any store they belong to stay as they are.
en.admin.makeAdminBody: They will reach every store, every product, commission, payouts and this page — everything you can. Only do this for somebody who runs NetLet.
en.admin.importFileHint: Use the template's columns. The file is read in your browser; nothing is sent until you press Create.
en.admin.importStoreNeeded: Choose the store first. Every row in the file goes to the one store chosen here.
en.sell.badLink: A document link has to be a full web address, like the one in your browser's address bar.
en.error.invalidInput: Something in that form is not in the shape we expected. Check it and try again.
en.dispatch.noCompanies: No delivery companies yet. Add the first one below.
en.dispatch.suspendBody: No new deliveries can be given to them, and their people lose the board. Parcels they already carried keep their history.
en.dispatch.removeMemberBody: They stop seeing this company's deliveries straight away. Their NetLet account stays.
en.admin.cardsOff: Gift cards are switched off, so no new ones can be made. Cards already sold stay listed and can still be spent.
en.admin.cardExpiresHint: Optional. The card can be spent until the end of this day, Kuwait time.
en.admin.codeEndsHint: The code works until the end of this day, Kuwait time.
en.admin.codeEditing: Editing {code}. Saving changes it for every shopper from now on; uses so far are kept.
en.admin.reviewNoteHint: Required to send it back. The seller reads it on the product's page.
en.admin.reviewIntro: Products a store has asked to publish. Approving puts one in the shop; sending one back needs a reason, written onto the product where the seller has to fix it.
en.admin.bundleNoItems: Nothing in it yet. Find a product below to add it.
en.admin.bundleSearchHint: Search by name or product code, then choose the exact option.
en.admin.affiliateRateHint: Percent of each sale, at most {ceiling}%.
en.admin.teamIntro: Everybody who can sign in to this store's portal, and what their rank lets them do.
en.admin.removeMemberBody: They lose access to this store in the portal straight away. Their NetLet account stays, and they can be added again later.
en.admin.lastOwner: This is the store's only owner. Make somebody else an owner first, so the store is never left without anyone who can run its team.
en.admin.stockIntro: What is running out, and every change to stock with its reason.
en.admin.overviewIntro: What is waiting for you, and how the shop stands.
en.admin.newStoreHint: The store that sells it. Its commission rate, delivery fee and discount permit apply to the product.
en.admin.movedBundles: {count} of the old store's bundles that included it were taken off the shop.
en.admin.moveBody: Its stock, photos, reviews and saved hearts go with it. Orders already placed stay with {from}, which sold them. From now on {store}'s commission rate and discount permit apply to it.
en.admin.sectionStoreNote: Which store sells this product. Only NetLet can move it to another.
en.admin.autoPublishHint: On: the store's products go live when it publishes them. Off: each one waits in the review queue.
en.admin.statusHint: Approved stores sell. A store awaiting approval is set up but not in the shop. Suspending a store takes its products out of the shop without changing them.
en.admin.sectionTermsNote: What NetLet charges the store, and whether its products need review. Saved as they change and recorded in the audit trail.
en.admin.sectionPaymentsNote: How shoppers pay this store, and where NetLet sends its money.
en.admin.sectionDeliveryNote: What this store charges to deliver, how fast, and who carries it.
en.admin.sectionContactNote: How NetLet reaches the store. Shoppers are never shown these.
en.admin.sectionProfileNote: How the store is named and shown to shoppers.
en.admin.vendorsIntro: Every store selling on NetLet. Open one to change its details, its terms or who can sign in for it.
en.admin.moveSameStore: It already belongs to that store.
en.admin.moveBlockedOffer: A shopper has asked this store for a price on it, or holds one the store agreed. Answer or let it lapse first, so the new store is not held to another store's price.
en.admin.moveBlockedNetlet: NetLet is holding or expecting this store's stock of the product. Return it to the store first, under Fulfilled by NetLet.
en.admin.moveBlockedAd: A paid placement for this product is running or booked, and it is charged to the store that booked it. Cancel it under Placements first.
en.admin.offerHiddenExpired: The was-price is not shown in the shop, because this store's discount permit has expired. The product sells at its price, and the saving appears again once the permit is renewed.
en.admin.offerHiddenMissing: The was-price is not shown in the shop, because this store has no discount permit recorded. The product sells at its price, and the saving appears once a valid permit is recorded.
en.admin.newSearchEmpty: Type the product's name to see how its search result will read.
en.admin.deleteSectionNote: Removes it for good, with its variants, photos and stock history. To take it out of the shop and keep it, move it to draft.
en.admin.deleteChecking: Checking what it is connected to…
en.admin.deleteTypeName: To confirm, type the product's name
en.admin.deleteUnpublishInstead: To take it out of the shop and keep it, move it to draft instead.
en.admin.deleteOpenOrders: {count} orders with it still need sending. They keep their copy of the product and stay on Orders.
en.admin.deleteBody: This removes the product, its variants, photos and stock history for good. Orders already placed keep their own copy.
en.admin.newDraftNote: A draft is saved but not in the shop. You can publish it from its page.
en.admin.newSearchAddDescription: Add a description so a search result has something to say about it.
en.admin.newSearchCut: Search results will cut this short.
en.admin.newSearchHint: Search engines show the product's name and the start of its description. This is how the result will read.
en.admin.newDescriptionHint: What it is, what it is made of, what comes in the box. Line breaks are kept.
en.admin.newStockHint: How many you have now. Later changes are recorded with a reason on the product's page.
en.admin.newSkuHint: Your own code for it. Each one is used once across your shop.
en.admin.newWasHint: Shown as a saving only while the store has a valid discount permit. Without one, the product sells at its price.
en.admin.newPhotosHint: The first photo is the one on the card. Square photos on a plain background work best.
en.admin.newTitleHint: What a shopper would type to find it: the brand, the product and the one detail that matters.
en.admin.newIntro: Start with what a shopper needs to decide. Sizes, specifications and extras can be added once it is created.
en.admin.newPhotoUrl: Paste a full web address, starting with {scheme}.
en.admin.newStockShape: Enter a whole number of items.
en.admin.newWasHigher: The was-price has to be higher than the price.
en.admin.newPricePositive: The price has to be more than zero.
en.admin.newTooLong: That is longer than this field holds.
en.admin.deleteBlockedNetlet: NetLet is holding or expecting stock of this product. Ask for it back under Fulfilled by NetLet first.
en.admin.deleteBlockedAd: A paid placement for this product is running or booked. Cancel it under Placements first.
en.account.hint.help: Ask NetLet about an order or your account
en.account.hint.offers: Special prices you asked sellers for
en.account.hint.wishlists: Lists to share with family and friends
en.account.hint.subscriptions: Orders that repeat on a schedule
en.home.heading: NetLet
en.admin.badgesEarned: High Rating and Fast Shipping are earned, never awarded. High Rating shows once a store averages {rating} stars over at least {reviews} reviews; Fast Shipping once {share}% of its deliveries in the last {days} days arrived within {hours} hours of the order, from at least {deliveries}.
en.checkout.parcelsNote: Each seller sends their own parcel, so an order from two shops can arrive as two deliveries.
en.features.articlesOff: The home page's guides are not shown. They stay on the guides page.
en.features.appBannerOff: The home page does not invite shoppers to the app.
en.features.photoSearchOff: The camera is not shown in the search box, and no photo is sent to a model.
en.tryOn.title: See it on you
en.tryOn.privacy: Choose a photo of yourself, facing the camera. NetLet sends it, with this product's photo, to Google's Gemini AI to draw you wearing it. NetLet keeps neither your photo nor the picture, and nobody else sees them.
en.tryOn.signIn: Sign in to try things on.
en.tryOn.madeByAi: Drawn by AI: a guide to the look, not the exact fit or colour.
en.tryOn.unreadable: That photo could not be read. Try another.
en.tryOn.notWearable: This product cannot be tried on.
en.tryOn.noProductPhoto: This product has no photo to try on yet.
en.features.tryOnOff: No product page offers to show a shopper wearing the item, and no shopper's photo is sent to a model.
en.features.why.tryOnWhere: Offered on clothing, shoes and accessories in the Style department, to signed-in shoppers.
en.features.voiceSearchOff: The microphone is not shown in the search box.
en.account.sectionFailed: This part of your account could not be loaded.
en.browse.emptySearchNote: Check the spelling, or try a shorter or more general word.
en.manufacturer.hint: Paste the address of this product on the maker's own site. NetLet reads the images the maker lists for the product, and you choose which to use.
en.manufacturer.urlLabel: The manufacturer's page for this product
en.manufacturer.noneFound: That page lists no product images NetLet can read. Try the product's own page rather than a category or the home page.
en.manufacturer.rights: Use a maker's images only where they allow sellers to; most do for their own products. NetLet keeps a note of where each one came from.
en.manufacturer.badUrl: That is not an address NetLet can read. Paste the full address of the product page, starting https://.
en.manufacturer.notHttps: Only secure pages, starting https://, can be read.
en.manufacturer.notAPage: That address is not a web page.
en.manufacturer.tooLarge: That is too large to fetch.
en.manufacturer.notAnImage: That is not an image NetLet can use.
en.manufacturer.tooSmall: Too small to use: under 300 pixels on its shorter side.
en.manufacturer.tooMany: That is a lot of fetching in an hour. Try again later.
en.manufacturer.searchHint: NetLet searches Google for this product's name and lists the pages it finds. Choose the maker's own one.
en.manufacturer.searchNone: No pages were found for this name. Paste the address instead.
en.manufacturer.needName: Give the product its name first, so there is something to search for.
en.manufacturer.searchOff: Searching is not available at the moment. Paste the address instead.
en.manufacturer.searchFailed: The search did not answer. Try again, or paste the address.
en.media.originalAlt: The image as found on the manufacturer's page
en.admin.payoutPrepareBody: This freezes the figure. Send exactly this amount; anything that comes due later goes in the next payout.
en.admin.payoutPrepareAllBody: Each figure is frozen as it stands now. A store with no valid IBAN is skipped and named.
en.admin.payoutNeedsIban: Record a valid IBAN on the store's page before preparing.
en.admin.payoutsWaitingNote: Frozen and counted as paid, but not yet out of the bank. Send each by hand and mark it sent, or put them in a bank file. Void one only if the bank did not make it: its money goes back into the store's next payout.
en.admin.payoutsNoneWaiting: Nothing is waiting to be sent.
en.admin.payoutMarkSentBody: Only once the transfer has left the bank. Bank reference: {reference}.
en.admin.payoutCancelBody: Only if the bank did not make it. The money goes back into the store's next payout.
en.admin.payoutFilesNote: Upload a file to your bank's bulk payment service. Downloading it again gives the same file with the same message id, so the bank refuses a second upload of it. ISO 20022 is the format most banks take for bulk transfers; the CSV is for a bank with its own spreadsheet template.
en.admin.payoutXmlUnavailable: ISO 20022 is unavailable until NetLet's own account is set up:
en.admin.payoutMarkFileTitle: Mark every waiting transfer in {file} as sent?
en.admin.payoutMarkFileBody: Only once the bank has made them. Bank reference: {reference}.
en.payouts.noIban: This store has no payout IBAN recorded.
en.payouts.badIban: This store's payout IBAN does not pass the bank check. Correct it on the store's page.
en.payouts.nothingPrepared: Nothing is waiting to be sent. Somebody may have just done it.
en.payouts.fileEmpty: Every transfer in this file was voided, so there is nothing to download.
en.payouts.noDebtorName: NetLet's account name is not set on the server (PAYOUT_FROM_NAME).
en.payouts.noDebtorIban: NetLet's own IBAN is not set on the server (PAYOUT_FROM_IBAN).
en.payouts.badDebtorIban: NetLet's own IBAN (PAYOUT_FROM_IBAN) does not pass the bank check.
en.payouts.badDebtorBic: NetLet's bank code (PAYOUT_FROM_BIC) is not a valid BIC.
en.fulfilment.chargesNote: What NetLet charged for packing each line, at the centre's rate when it was packed. Each comes off the seller's next payout run as a fee line.
en.fulfilment.packRateFor: Packing rate per unit at {centre}, in KWD
en.fulfilment.badRate: Enter a rate like 0.250, or leave it blank for no charge.
en.support.otherChannelsNote: These conversations happen on WhatsApp or the phone, not here. If you chose an order above, WhatsApp opens with its reference written in.
en.membership.title: Membership
en.membership.adminNote: NetLet membership: free delivery, member prices and first place in the dispatch queue. Buying a membership waits on payments, so for now NetLet grants it — to staff, a pilot group, or a shopper it owes an apology. A member's free delivery is NetLet's cost: each seller's fee stands, and the order records what was waived.
en.membership.reportWaived: Delivery carried for members this month
en.membership.freeOverHint: Leave blank for free delivery on every member order. Under this amount a member pays delivery like anybody else.
en.membership.grantNote: By the account's email. A second grant starts when the first ends, so it extends rather than overlaps.
en.membership.endBody: Benefits stop now. Orders already placed keep their member prices and free delivery — those were part of the sale.
en.membership.notFound: That membership was not found, or has already ended.
en.membership.memberPriceHint: What NetLet members pay. Blank for none. Shown only to members, and only while your discount permit is valid.
en.membership.priceNotBelow: A member price must be below the price.
en.membership.priceZero: A member price must be more than zero.
en.membership.deliveryWaived: Free delivery with your membership — you save {amount}.
en.membership.benefitDeliveryOver: Free delivery on orders of {amount} or more.
en.membership.benefitPrices: Member prices where a seller offers them, shown on the product and charged at checkout.
en.membership.benefitPriority: Your parcels go first in the queue for the next driver.
en.features.membershipOff: No new memberships can be granted. Members keep every benefit until their membership runs out.
en.fulfilment.title: Fulfilled by NetLet
en.fulfilment.sellerNote: Send stock to a NetLet fulfilment centre and NetLet holds it, picks it and packs it when it sells. Once NetLet counts a shipment in, the shop sells from NetLet's shelf for that item, and only NetLet's counts change it.
en.fulfilment.operatorNote: NetLet's own floor: count sellers' shipments in, pick and pack what sold, and send stock back. Delivery companies collect packed parcels from the centre through the dispatch board.
en.fulfilment.notOpen: NetLet has not opened a fulfilment centre yet, so there is nowhere to send stock. When one opens, you can send stock from this page.
en.fulfilment.sendNote: Say what you are sending. Nothing changes in the shop until NetLet counts it in, and what NetLet counts is what is recorded.
en.fulfilment.blockedPreorder: has a pre-order allowance, which NetLet cannot hold
en.fulfilment.announced: Shipment {reference} announced. Write the reference on the boxes.
en.fulfilment.tooManyLines: That is too many items for one shipment. Split it in two.
en.fulfilment.badQuantity: Each quantity must be a whole number from 1 to {max}.
en.fulfilment.duplicateLine: An item is on the shipment twice.
en.fulfilment.noCentre: That fulfilment centre is not taking shipments.
en.fulfilment.notYourVariant: That item is not one of your store's.
en.fulfilment.otherCentre: That item is already held at another centre. One item is held in one place.
en.fulfilment.preorderVariant: That item has a pre-order allowance. Set it to zero before sending stock to NetLet.
en.fulfilment.notAnnounced: That shipment has already been counted or cancelled.
en.fulfilment.countMissing: Count every line, even if nothing arrived.
en.fulfilment.notHeld: NetLet is not holding that item.
en.fulfilment.netletHolds: NetLet holds this item's stock, so only NetLet's counts change it.
en.fulfilment.noPreorder: NetLet holds this item, so it cannot take pre-orders.
en.fulfilment.netletShips: NetLet picks and packs this line from its centre.
en.fulfilment.recordCountBody: The counted units go onto NetLet's shelf and the shop sells them from there. An item NetLet did not hold before is handed over: the shop stops selling the seller's own stock of it.
en.fulfilment.sendBackBody: {count} units leave NetLet's shelf and the item goes back to the seller's own stock, at zero until they count it. Lines already sold from NetLet stay NetLet's to pack.
en.fulfilment.pickNote: Lines sold from a NetLet centre, oldest order first. Marking an order packed tells the dispatch board it is ready to collect.
en.fulfilment.packedToast: {count} lines packed and ready to collect.
en.fulfilment.pickTruncated: Showing the oldest orders only. Pack these and the rest will appear.
en.fulfilment.centresNote: Sellers can send stock only once a centre is open. Closing one stops new shipments; what it already holds stays and still ships.
en.fulfilment.noCentres: No centre yet. Opening the first one starts the programme.
en.features.fulfilmentOff: Sellers cannot announce new shipments. What is already on its way is still counted in, what NetLet holds still sells, and sold lines are still picked and packed.
en.support.askNote: Questions about an order, a delivery, a return or your account. You get an automatic answer straight away from your order's details, and a person from NetLet reads every message.
en.support.none: You have not asked NetLet anything yet.
en.support.automaticSent: Automatic answer the shopper was given
en.support.inboxNote: Shoppers writing to NetLet itself. Each conversation shows the automatic answer the shopper already got, so a reply can pick up where it left off.
en.support.pickOne: Choose a conversation to read it.
en.support.draftNote: Drafted by an AI model from this conversation and the order's facts — never the shopper's name or contact details. Read it and change anything before sending; nothing goes to the shopper until you press Send.
en.support.draftUnavailable: No draft this time. Write the reply yourself.
en.support.nothingToAnswer: The shopper has been answered already, so there is nothing new to draft a reply to.
en.support.answerOrderStatus: Where the items on {reference} are now — being prepared: {preparing} · on the way: {onTheWay} · delivered: {delivered}.
en.support.answerTrack: Something on it is on the road now — open the order on this page to see where the driver is, when they are sharing their location.
en.support.answerCancelled: {count} of its items were cancelled by the seller and are not charged.
en.support.answerChooseOrder: Choose the order this is about and we can look it up straight away; your orders are listed at the top of this page.
en.support.answerReturnOpen: Items on {reference} can still be returned: open the order at the top of this page and press Return or exchange on the item.
en.support.answerReturnClosed: Nothing on {reference} can be returned from your account right now — a return is open for {days} days from delivery, and only once the item has arrived.
en.support.answerReturnPolicy: You can return an item within {days} days of its delivery from the order at the top of this page. A damaged, faulty or wrong item is always accepted in that time.
en.support.answerPayment: NetLet takes cash on delivery: you pay the driver when your parcel arrives, and nothing is charged before.
en.support.answerPaid: The cash for {reference} has been recorded as collected.
en.support.answerUnpaid: Nothing has been collected for {reference} yet; you pay when it arrives.
en.support.answerAccount: If you cannot sign in, press Forgot your password? on the sign-in screen and we will email you a link. Your name, email and password can be changed under Your details on this page.

en.sellerTerms.store.title: Your store
en.sellerTerms.store.yours: You sell your own goods under your store's name, and you are responsible for them being as described, safe and lawful to sell in Kuwait. NetLet issues one invoice per order and names you on it as the seller, with your commercial registration, or says that you sell under NetLet's licence when that is what was agreed.
en.sellerTerms.store.documents: Before a store opens, NetLet checks your trade licence (unless you sell under NetLet's licence), the civil ID of the person signing for the store, and a letter for a bank account in the store's name. Keep them current: an expired licence or a changed account is yours to update.
en.sellerTerms.listings.title: Listings
en.sellerTerms.listings.honest: A listing shows what you are actually selling: your own photographs or ones the maker lets sellers use, an honest description, a price above zero, and, for electronics, the warranty you give.
en.sellerTerms.listings.review: Until NetLet marks your store as trusted, a new listing waits for NetLet to review it before shoppers can see it.
en.sellerTerms.listings.warnings: A listing NetLet turns down counts as a warning. Three warnings suspend the store automatically, which takes every listing off the shop until NetLet reinstates it.
en.sellerTerms.prices.title: Prices and discounts
en.sellerTerms.prices.permit: You set your own prices. A struck-through "was" price or a percentage off is shown only while your Ministry of Commerce discount permit is recorded on your store and in date; without one, the product still sells at its price and no saving is shown.
en.sellerTerms.prices.requests: If you take price requests, a request you have not answered within {askDays} days lapses, and a price you agree is held for that shopper for {offerDays} days. A shopper is never charged more than your current price because of an agreed one.
en.sellerTerms.commission.title: Commission
en.sellerTerms.commission.rate: NetLet's commission is {commission}% of the price of the goods on each sale, unless a different rate is agreed and recorded on your store. Only NetLet sets or changes it, every change is logged with who made it, and it is not taken on delivery.
en.sellerTerms.commission.frozen: The rate in force when an order is placed is copied onto that order, so a later change never reaches back to sales already made.
en.sellerTerms.payouts.title: Payouts
en.sellerTerms.payouts.when: You are paid the sale less NetLet's commission. Cash collected at the door is paid out {codDays} business days after the driver collects it, counting Sunday to Thursday, by transfer to the account on your store. Every transfer is listed with its bank reference on your payouts page.
en.sellerTerms.payouts.deductions: A refund made after a payout comes off your next one. Paid placements, and packing fees when NetLet packs your orders, are deducted the same way, and only for what actually ran or was packed.
en.sellerTerms.delivery.title: Delivery
en.sellerTerms.delivery.terms: You set your own delivery fee, the order value over which you deliver free, and how fast you ship, and those are what shoppers are charged and shown. Ship each order within the speed you chose, with the delivery company you name.
en.sellerTerms.delivery.damage: Damage in transit is claimed against the delivery company that carried the parcel, which answers before NetLet decides.
en.sellerTerms.delivery.cancel: If you cannot supply an item, cancel its line before it is paid: its stock goes back, and the shopper is not asked to pay for it.
en.sellerTerms.returns.title: Returns
en.sellerTerms.returns.window: Shoppers may return an item within {days} days of delivery. A damaged, faulty or wrong item, or one not as described, is accepted at once; a change of mind is accepted too, except on groceries and other perishable goods. Anything else is decided by a person.
en.sellerTerms.returns.refund: An accepted return is refunded at the price the item was sold at, or exchanged when you have it in stock.
en.sellerTerms.conduct.title: Talking to shoppers
en.sellerTerms.conduct.contact: Talk to shoppers through NetLet. Messages and replies to reviews may not carry phone numbers, email addresses, links or social media handles, and are refused if they do. Arranging a sale outside NetLet breaks this agreement. NetLet may read any conversation to keep the marketplace safe.
en.sellerTerms.conduct.data: Use a shopper's name, phone number and address only to fulfil their order, and keep them no longer than that needs.
en.sellerTerms.placements.title: Paid placements
en.sellerTerms.placements.body: You may book your products into paid places on the shop. A booking is made against what you have earned, charged only for the days it actually ran, and labelled as sponsored wherever it shows. Home page banners are approved by NetLet before they run.
en.sellerTerms.ending.title: Suspension and closing
en.sellerTerms.ending.body: You may close your store at any time by asking through Help. NetLet may suspend or close it for a breach of this agreement or of Kuwaiti law.
en.sellerTerms.ending.paid: What you earned on delivered orders that were not refunded is still paid out after a store is suspended or closed.
en.sellerTerms.law.title: Changes and the law
en.sellerTerms.law.changes: NetLet publishes any new version of this agreement on this page, with its date, before it applies.
en.sellerTerms.law.kuwait: This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Kuwait, and the courts of Kuwait decide any dispute about it.

en.privacy.title: Privacy policy
en.privacy.intro: This page explains what NetLet keeps about you, why, and who else sees it. NetLet is run by {operator}.
en.privacy.introPlain: This page explains what NetLet keeps about you, why, and who else sees it.
en.privacy.keep.title: What we keep
en.privacy.keep.account: Your account: your name, your email address and your language. Your password is held as a one-way code by our sign-in service, so nobody at NetLet can read it.
en.privacy.keep.orders: Your orders: what you bought, the delivery addresses and phone number you gave, and the map pin if you placed one.
en.privacy.keep.writing: What you write to us or to a store — messages, reviews and return requests — and the products and lists you save.
en.privacy.keep.selling: If you apply to sell: your store's details and the documents you upload, which only you and NetLet's administrators can open.
en.privacy.device.title: What stays on your device
en.privacy.device.body: Two things are kept only in your browser and never sent to us: your recent searches, and your measurements if you ask the size guide to remember them.
en.privacy.why.title: Why we use it
en.privacy.why.orders: To take your order and bring it to your door, to show you your account, to answer you when you ask for help, and to issue the invoices the law requires.
en.privacy.why.abuse: To stop fraud and abuse: we count failed sign-ins and some repeated requests by network (IP) address, and keep those counts only for a short time.
en.privacy.why.picked: “Picked for you” uses what you saved, added to your bag and bought on NetLet. Only general interest words leave NetLet for it — never your name, email or orders.
en.privacy.who.title: Who else sees it
en.privacy.who.stores: The stores you order from, and the company delivering for them, see what they need to deliver: your name, address, phone number and the items. In messages and reviews a store sees your first name and initial, never your email.
en.privacy.who.services: The services that run NetLet for us: our hosting (Vercel), and our database and sign-in service (Supabase), which also sends your verification codes and password emails.
en.privacy.who.email: Our email service (Resend) sends the updates in your NetLet inbox to your email address — your orders, the items you follow, replies to your messages — unless you turn that off in your notifications.
en.privacy.who.tryOn: When you try a product on, the photo of yourself you choose goes, with the product's photo, to Google's Gemini AI model to draw you wearing it. NetLet does not keep your photo or the picture it draws.
en.privacy.who.google: When you create an account, Google's reCAPTCHA checks that you are not a robot. When you place a pin, the map you choose — Google Maps, Apple Maps or OpenStreetMap — loads in your browser.
en.privacy.who.ai: When you ask the shop assistant, a product's assistant or the help page a question, or search with a photo, the question or the photo goes to Google's Gemini AI model, through a NetLet service that runs on Cloudflare, with the product's own text where you are on one; your name, email, address and orders do not. When you search by voice, your browser's own speech service hears it.
en.privacy.who.drivers: If you deliver for NetLet, your location is shared only while you switch sharing on, and only with the shopper whose parcel you are carrying.
en.privacy.who.sell: We do not sell your information, and we do not share it for advertising.
en.privacy.cookies.title: Cookies
en.privacy.cookies.body: NetLet sets one cookie, to keep you signed in, and no advertising cookies. On the Create account form, Google's reCAPTCHA may set cookies of its own.
en.privacy.cookies.analytics: We count visits with an analytics tool that sets no cookies and does not identify you.
en.privacy.long.title: How long we keep it
en.privacy.long.body: Your account details for as long as your account is open. Orders and invoices for as long as Kuwaiti law requires a business to keep its records, even after an account is closed.
en.privacy.choices.title: Your choices
en.privacy.choices.body: You can see and change your name, email, password, addresses and language from Your account. To close your account and delete what we hold, ask us through Help; we keep only what the law requires.
en.privacy.changes.title: Changes
en.privacy.changes.body: If this policy changes, the date at the top changes with it.

ar.membership.adminNote: عضوية نت‑لت: توصيل مجاني، وأسعار للأعضاء، وأولوية في قائمة التوصيل. شراء العضوية ينتظر وسائل الدفع، لذلك تمنحها نت‑لت الآن — للموظفين أو لمجموعة تجريبية أو لمتسوق تدين له باعتذار. التوصيل المجاني للعضو تتحمله نت‑لت: تبقى رسوم كل بائع كما هي، ويسجّل الطلب ما تم إعفاؤه.

ar.terms.liability.body: نعمل على أن يبقى نت‑لت دقيقاً ومتاحاً، لكننا لا نستطيع ضمان ذلك دائماً. وفي الحدود التي يسمح بها القانون الكويتي، لا يتحمّل نت‑لت مسؤولية الخسائر الناتجة عن منتج أحد المتاجر أو عن تعذّر الوصول إلى الموقع. ولا يسلبك شيء في هذه الشروط الحقوق التي يمنحها لك القانون الكويتي بصفتك مستهلكاً.

ar.sellerTerms.parties.body: «نت‑لت» هو السوق ومن يديره، و«أنت» المتجر: الشركة، أو الشخص الذي يبيع بترخيص نت‑لت، كما ورد في طلبك. يشتري المتسوّقون منك، ويحمل نت‑لت الطلب بينكما: الإعلان عن المنتج والسلة والمبلغ المحصَّل نقداً عند الباب والفاتورة والتحويل إليك.

ar.sellerTerms.store.title: متجرك
ar.sellerTerms.store.yours: تبيع بضاعتك باسم متجرك، وأنت مسؤول عن أن تكون كما وُصفت، وآمنة، وجائزاً بيعها في الكويت. يُصدر نت‑لت فاتورة واحدة لكل طلب ويذكرك فيها بائعاً مع سجلك التجاري، أو يذكر أنك تبيع بترخيص نت‑لت إن كان هذا ما اتُّفق عليه.
ar.sellerTerms.store.documents: قبل افتتاح المتجر يتحقق نت‑لت من رخصتك التجارية (إلا إن كنت تبيع بترخيص نت‑لت)، ومن البطاقة المدنية للشخص الذي يوقّع عن المتجر، ومن رسالة بحساب مصرفي باسم المتجر. أبقِها سارية: تحديث الرخصة المنتهية أو الحساب المتغيّر مسؤوليتك.

ar.sellerTerms.delivery.terms: تحدد بنفسك رسوم التوصيل، وقيمة الطلب التي يصبح التوصيل فوقها مجانياً، وسرعة الشحن، وهذه هي ما يُحاسَب عليه المتسوّقون ويرونه. اشحن كل طلب ضمن السرعة التي اخترتها، مع شركة التوصيل التي تحددها.

ar.sellerTerms.conduct.title: التواصل مع المتسوّقين
ar.sellerTerms.conduct.contact: تواصل مع المتسوّقين عبر نت‑لت. لا يجوز أن تحمل الرسائل أو الردود على التقييمات أرقام هواتف أو عناوين بريد إلكتروني أو روابط أو حسابات تواصل اجتماعي، وتُرفض إن حملتها. وترتيب بيع خارج نت‑لت إخلال بهذه الاتفاقية. ويحق لنت‑لت قراءة أي محادثة حفاظاً على سلامة السوق.
ar.sellerTerms.conduct.data: استخدم اسم المتسوّق ورقم هاتفه وعنوانه لتنفيذ طلبه فقط، ولا تحتفظ بها أطول مما يحتاجه ذلك.

ar.privacy.keep.title: ما نحتفظ به
ar.privacy.keep.account: حسابك: اسمك وبريدك الإلكتروني ولغتك. وتُحفظ كلمة المرور لدى خدمة تسجيل الدخول بصيغة مشفّرة لا يمكن عكسها، فلا يستطيع أحد في نت‑لت قراءتها.
ar.privacy.keep.orders: طلباتك: ما اشتريته، وعناوين التوصيل ورقم الهاتف الذي أدخلته، وموقعك على الخريطة إن حدّدته.
ar.privacy.keep.writing: ما تكتبه إلينا أو إلى المتاجر — الرسائل والتقييمات وطلبات الإرجاع — والمنتجات والقوائم التي تحفظها.
ar.privacy.keep.selling: إذا تقدّمت للبيع: بيانات متجرك والمستندات التي ترفعها، ولا يفتحها إلا أنت ومشرفو نت‑لت.

ar.privacy.device.body: هناك أمران يُحفظان في متصفحك فقط ولا يُرسلان إلينا أبداً: عمليات بحثك الأخيرة، ومقاساتك إذا طلبت من دليل المقاسات تذكّرها.
ar.privacy.why.title: لماذا نستخدمها
ar.privacy.why.orders: لاستلام طلبك وإيصاله إلى بابك، ولعرض حسابك، وللرد عليك حين تطلب المساعدة، ولإصدار الفواتير التي يفرضها القانون.
ar.privacy.why.abuse: لمنع الاحتيال وإساءة الاستخدام: نحصي محاولات تسجيل الدخول الفاشلة وبعض الطلبات المتكررة حسب عنوان الشبكة (IP)، ولا نحتفظ بهذه الأعداد إلا لمدة قصيرة.
ar.privacy.why.picked: يعتمد قسم «مختارة لك» على ما حفظته وأضفته إلى سلتك واشتريته على نت‑لت. ولا يخرج من نت‑لت لأجله سوى كلمات عامة عن اهتماماتك — لا اسمك ولا بريدك ولا طلباتك.
ar.privacy.who.title: من يطّلع عليها أيضاً
ar.privacy.who.stores: المتاجر التي تطلب منها، وشركة التوصيل التي تعمل لها، ترى ما تحتاجه للتوصيل: اسمك وعنوانك ورقم هاتفك والمنتجات. وفي الرسائل والتقييمات لا يرى المتجر إلا اسمك الأول والحرف الأول من اسم العائلة، ولا يرى بريدك أبداً.
ar.privacy.who.services: الخدمات التي تشغّل نت‑لت لصالحنا: الاستضافة (Vercel)، وقاعدة البيانات وخدمة تسجيل الدخول (Supabase) التي ترسل أيضاً رموز التحقق ورسائل كلمة المرور.
ar.privacy.who.email: ترسل خدمة البريد لدينا (Resend) التحديثات التي تصل إلى صندوق إشعاراتك في نت‑لت إلى بريدك الإلكتروني — طلباتك والمنتجات التي تتابعها والردود على رسائلك — ما لم توقف ذلك في إشعاراتك.
ar.privacy.who.tryOn: عندما تجرّب منتجاً عليك، تُرسل صورتك التي تختارها، مع صورة المنتج، إلى نموذج Gemini للذكاء الاصطناعي من Google ليرسمك وأنت ترتديه. ولا تحتفظ نت‑لت بصورتك ولا بالصورة التي يرسمها.
ar.privacy.who.google: عند إنشاء حساب، تتحقّق خدمة reCAPTCHA من Google من أنك لست برنامجاً آلياً. وعند تحديد موقعك على الخريطة، تُحمَّل في متصفحك الخريطة التي تختارها — Google Maps أو Apple Maps أو OpenStreetMap.
ar.privacy.who.ai: عندما تسأل مساعد المتجر أو مساعد المنتج أو صفحة المساعدة، أو تبحث بصورة، يُرسَل السؤال أو الصورة إلى نموذج Gemini للذكاء الاصطناعي من Google، عبر خدمة لنت لت تعمل على Cloudflare، مع نص المنتج نفسه إن كنت على صفحته، دون اسمك أو بريدك أو عنوانك أو طلباتك. وعندما تبحث بصوتك، تستمع إليك خدمة الكلام في متصفحك.
ar.privacy.who.drivers: إذا كنت توصّل الطلبات لنت‑لت، فلا يُشارَك موقعك إلا حين تفعّل المشاركة، ومع المتسوّق الذي تحمل طرده فقط.
ar.privacy.who.sell: لا نبيع معلوماتك، ولا نشاركها لأغراض الإعلان.
